title: Run control
_comment: Declarative field definitions for the controlDict form editor (§5.4).
Adding support for a new OpenFOAM version is predominantly a data change,
not a code change — which only holds if nothing here leaks into Python.
Enum values are taken from what the tutorial corpus actually contains, not
from the User Guide. 'adjustable' is the case in point: PRD §5.4's example
lists 'adjustableRunTime', but real files overwhelmingly use the shorter
alias, and a schema that rejected it would flag valid tutorials as broken.
Any key present in a file but absent from here is preserved untouched and
shown in the raw-text tab (FR-P6, §5.4). This list is what the form can
edit, never what a file is allowed to contain.

fields.label: Solver
fields.help: The OpenFOAM solver this case runs.

fields.label: Start from
fields.help: Which time to begin at. 'latestTime' continues from the newest written result.

fields.label: Stop at
fields.help: 'writeNow' is how a graceful stop is requested while a run is in progress.

fields.label: Time step
fields.help: The initial step. With adjustTimeStep on, it changes to hold maxCo.

fields.label: Write interval
fields.help: Interpreted in the units writeControl selects — steps, or seconds of simulated time.

fields.label: Keep last N results
fields.help: 0 keeps every written time. A non-zero value discards older ones as the run proceeds.

fields.label: Write format
fields.help: Binary is smaller and faster; ascii can be read and edited by hand.

fields.label: Time directory format
fields.help: How written time directories are named.

fields.label: Re-read settings while running
fields.help: Lets the solver notice edits mid-run. Required for the fallback stop path (FR-S5).

fields.label: Adjust time step automatically
fields.help: Varies deltaT to hold the Courant number at maxCo. Usual for transient multiphase cases.

fields.label: Maximum Courant number
fields.help: Above about 1 an explicit scheme usually becomes unstable.

fields.label: Maximum interface Courant number
fields.help: Applies at the phase interface in a VOF case.
